name: gpd-arxiv
description: Optional arXiv bridge for arxiv-mcp-server. Advertises the baseline upstream tools search_papers, download_paper, list_papers, read_paper, get_abstract, forwards only tools exposed by the live upstream server, and adds GPD download_source for raw source archives, recent_papers for verified new paper listings from arXiv, Zenodo and OpenAlex and paper_citations for references and citing works.
prerequisites: Install GPD before enabling built-in MCP servers.
Install GPD with the `arxiv` Python extra in the same environment before enabling gpd-arxiv.

python_module.notes: Replace `${GPD_PYTHON}` with a Python >=3.11 interpreter that has GPD installed.

availability_condition: Available only when the optional Python module 'arxiv_mcp_server' is installed.
